newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen opening higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen opening higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks should open higher Monday, pushed by momentum from the Dow industrials' record close Thursday, analysts said.
New York markets will be boosted by "a combination of Thursday and the enthusiasm that continues to percolate," said Larry Wachtel, an analyst at Prudential Securities.

There is no economic data out Monday that could affect markets, the analysts said. The U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was up 11/32 to yield 6.60 percent. The Standard & Poor's 500 futures index was up 2.40 at 930.15.
